description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the FormatWithEmptyString class within the OrangeHRM project. It verifies that the getFormattedValue method returns an empty string for given inputs.

classes.name: FormatWithEmptyStringTest
classes.description: Test class for FormatWithEmptyString, verifying its behavior in formatting values to an empty string.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case environment, creating an instance of FormatWithEmptyString.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that the getFormattedValue method returns an empty string for sample inputs like 'Middle Name' and 'Nickname'.
